prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Grocery bags landing on the counter in rhythmic thuds, one after another. Hands unpack in a fast choreography — vegetables into drawers, fruit into a bowl in a cascade, jars sliding into cabinets — everything finding its place in one flowing motion. Money shot: the fridge door opening to reveal perfectly stocked, glowing shelves, camera pushing slowly into the organized abundance. Final beat: leaning against the counter with a cup of coffee, calm, the kitchen golden and done. Warm side light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the bag thuds, then the fridge seal opening. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Uma ida ao mercado. Uma lista certa. Sete jantares resolvidos — sem voltar na terça porque esqueceu o alho.

Quando a lista sai do cardápio da semana, ela vem completa e organizada por corredor.

Manda pra quem vai ao mercado 4 vezes por semana 👇
